exclusions.source_text: Active known second malignancy with exception of adequately treated basal cell carcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma of the skin, or in situ cervical cancer; adequately treated Stage 1 cancer from which the subject is currently in remission and has been in remission for ≥2 years; low-risk prostate cancer with a Gleason score \<7 and a PSA level \<10 ng/mL; any other cancer from which the subject has been disease-free for ≥3 years
exclusions.threshold: disease-free for ≥3 years (other cancers); remission ≥2 years (Stage 1)

exclusions.source_text: Known central nervous system involvement by multiple myeloma
